escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing via X-Forwarded-For header forgery
escalations.description: proxy-addr (via Express 4.18.2) fails to validate X-Forwarded-For headers, allowing attackers to forge their source IP and bypass IP-based access controls.
escalations.exploit_scenario: Unauthenticated attacker on the network sets X-Forwarded-For to a trusted IP. Any IP-based access control or rate-limiting relying on req.ip is bypassed.
escalations.fix: npm update express to >=4.22.3 or 5.3.0+ in all projects

escalations.title: Vitest dev server arbitrary file read/execution
escalations.description: Vitest dev server (versions <5.0.5) allows unauthenticated file system reads and potential code execution when the dev server is network-accessible.
escalations.exploit_scenario: If vitest --ui or vitest watch port is reachable from the network, attacker reads arbitrary host files (env files, SSH keys, source outside project root).
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >=5.0.5 in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

escalations.title: @vitest/mocker arbitrary code injection via mock registration
escalations.description: @vitest/mocker allows arbitrary code injection through mock registration, enabling supply-chain or insider attacks via crafted test files.
escalations.exploit_scenario: Malicious or compromised test file exploits mock registration to execute arbitrary code in the test runner (CI/CD pipeline).
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >=5.0.5 (resolves both DA-002 and DA-004)

p1.title: GET /api/search not registered in app.ts — always 404 in production
p1.description: The search route is tested (5 test cases) but never registered. DependencyPicker typeahead always returns 404.
p1.exploit_scenario: User opens DependencyPicker. Every keystroke fires GET /api/search which returns 404. Typeahead silently fails. Dependency search feature is non-functional.
p1.fix: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts, implement GET /api/search?q=, register in app.ts. Re-enable 5 test cases.

p1.title: body-parser DoS via malformed compressed request body
p1.description: body-parser throws unhandled exception on malformed deflate/gzip request bodies, crashing the Express process.
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends POST with malformed compressed body to any endpoint. Express process crashes. Service is down until restarted.
p1.fix: Resolved by Express upgrade >=4.22.3 (same fix as DA-001)

p2.title: dependency_check_duration_seconds Prometheus histogram missing
p2.description: Spec requires 4 metrics. Only 3 counters exist. The histogram for dependency check duration is absent.
p2.fix: Add dependency_check_duration_seconds histogram to metrics.ts. Record duration in the dependency check service method.

p2.title: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx component test files missing

p2.fix: Create DependencySection.test.tsx, BlockedBadge.test.tsx, and DependencyPicker.test.tsx. Remove false meta-test claim.
